verses.sa: समास्त्वाग्न ऋतवो वर्धयन्तु संवत्सरा ऋषयो यानि सत्या। सं दिव्येन दीदिहि रोचनेन विश्वा आ भाहि प्रदिशश्चतस्रः॥
verses.tr: samāstvāgna ṛtavo vardhayantu saṃvatsarā ṛṣayo yāni satyā saṃ divyena dīdihi rocanena viśvā ā bhāhi pradiśaścatasraḥ
verses.en: Half-years and Seasons strengthen thee, O Agni, the Years and all the Verities and Rishis! Flash forth with thy celestial effulgence: illumine all four regions of the heaven.

verses.sa: सं चेध्यस्वाग्ने प्र च बोधयैनमुच्च तिष्ठ महते सौभगाय। मा च रिषदुपसत्ता ते अग्ने ब्रह्माणस्ते यशसः सन्तु मान्ये॥
verses.tr: saṃ cedhyasvāgne pra ca bodhayainamucca tiṣṭha mahate saubhagāya mā ca riṣadupasattā te agne brahmāṇaste yaśasaḥ santu mānye
verses.en: Kindle thee, Agni, wake this man to knowledge: rise up erect for great and happy fortune. Agni, be those uninjured who adore thee, thy priests be glorious and none beside them!

verses.sa: त्वामग्ने वृणते ब्राह्मणा इमे शिवो अग्ने संवरणे भवा नः। सपत्नहा नो अभिमातिजिच्च स्वे गये गागृह्यप्रयुच्छन्॥
verses.tr: tvāmagne vṛṇate brāhmaṇā ime śivo agne saṃvaraṇe bhavā naḥ sapatnahā no abhimātijicca sve gaye gāgṛhyaprayucchan
verses.en: The Brahmans present here elect thee, Agni: be thou propitious in our sanctuary. Slayer of rivals, Agni, quell our foemen: watch in thy house with care that never ceases.

verses.sa: इहैवाग्ने अधि धारया रयिं मा त्वा नि क्रन्पूर्वचितो निकारिणः। क्षत्रमग्ने सुयममस्तु तुभ्यमुपसत्ता वर्धतां ते अनिष्टृतः॥
verses.tr: ihaivāgne adhi dhārayā rayiṃ mā tvā ni kranpūrvacito nikāriṇaḥ kṣatramagne suyamamastu tubhyamupasattā vardhatāṃ te aniṣṭṛtaḥ
verses.en: Even here do thou, O Agni, stablish wealth: let not oppressors injure thee by thinking of thee first. Light be thy task of ruling, Agni, with thy power: may he who worships thee wax strong, invincible.

verses.sa: क्षत्रेणाग्ने स्वायुः सं रभस्व मित्रेणाग्ने मित्रधेये यतस्व। सजातानां मध्यमस्था एधि राज्ञामग्ने विहव्यो दीदिहीह॥
verses.tr: kṣatreṇāgne svāyuḥ saṃ rabhasva mitreṇāgne mitradheye yatasva sajātānāṃ madhyamasthā edhi rājñāmagne vihavyo dīdihīha
verses.en: Kind to the people, grasp thy power, O Agni: contend thou with the Friend by way of friendship. Placed, Agni, in the centre of our kinsmen, flash forth to be invoked by Kings around thee.

verses.sa: अति निहो अति स्रिधोऽत्यचित्तिमत्यरातिमग्ने। विश्वा ह्यग्ने दुरिता सहस्वाथास्मभ्यं सहवीरां रयिं दाः॥
verses.tr: ati niho ati sridho'tyacittimatyarātimagne viśvā hyagne duritā sahasvāthāsmabhyaṃ sahavīrāṃ rayiṃ dāḥ
verses.en: Past those who slay, past enemies, past thoughtless men, past those who hate,—Yea, Agni, drive away all woe and trouble: vouchsafe us opulence with men about us.

verses.sa: अनाधृष्यो जातवेदा अनिष्टृतो विराडग्ने क्षत्रभृद्दीदिहीह। विश्वा आशाः प्रमुञ्चन्मानुषीर्भियः शिवेभिरद्य परि पाहि नो वृधे॥
verses.tr: anādhṛṣyo jātavedā aniṣṭṛto virāḍagne kṣatrabhṛddīdihīha viśvā āśāḥ pramuñcanmānuṣīrbhiyaḥ śivebhiradya pari pāhi no vṛdhe
verses.en: Holder of sway, shine here refulgent, Agni! invincible, unconquered Jatavedas. Light all the regions, chasing human terrors: with happy helps guard us to-day for increase.

verses.sa: बृहस्पते सवितर्बोधयैनं संशितं चित्सन्तरां सं शिशाधि। वर्धयैनं महते सौभगाय विश्व एनमनु मदन्तु देवाः॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspate savitarbodhayainaṃ saṃśitaṃ citsantarāṃ saṃ śiśādhi vardhayainaṃ mahate saubhagāya viśva enamanu madantu devāḥ
verses.en: Brihaspati, Savitar, give this man knowledge: sharpen him thoroughly though already sharpened. To great and high felicity exalt him: in him let all the Gods rejoice and triumph.

verses.sa: अमुत्रभूयादध यद्यमस्य बृहस्पते अभिशस्तेरमुञ्चः। प्रत्यौहतामश्विना मृत्युमस्माद्देवानामग्ने भिषजा शचीभिः॥
verses.tr: amutrabhūyādadha yadyamasya bṛhaspate abhiśasteramuñcaḥ pratyauhatāmaśvinā mṛtyumasmāddevānāmagne bhiṣajā śacībhiḥ
verses.en: As thou, Brihaspati, from curse hast freed us, from dwelling yonder in the realm of Yama, The Asvins, Leeches of the Gods, O Agni, have chased Death far from us with mighty powers,

verses.sa: उद्वयं तमसस्परि स्वः पश्यन्त उत्तरम्। देवं देवत्रा सूर्यमगन्म ज्योतिरुत्तमम्॥
verses.tr: udvayaṃ tamasaspari svaḥ paśyanta uttaram devaṃ devatrā sūryamaganma jyotiruttamam
verses.en: Looking upon the loftier light, etc., as in XX. 31.

verses.sa: ऊर्ध्वा अस्य समिधो भवन्त्यूर्ध्वा शुक्रा शोचींष्यग्नेः। द्युमत्तमा सुप्रतीकस्य सूनोः॥
verses.tr: ūrdhvā asya samidho bhavantyūrdhvā śukrā śocīṃṣyagneḥ dyumattamā supratīkasya sūnoḥ
verses.en: Uplifted are the brands that are his fuel: lofty and brilliant are the flames of Agni, Splendidly bright of the Son fair of aspect.

verses.sa: तनूनपादसुरो विश्ववेदा देवो देवेषु देवः। पथो अनक्तु मध्वा घृतेन॥
verses.tr: tanūnapādasuro viśvavedā devo deveṣu devaḥ patho anaktu madhvā ghṛtena
verses.en: Tanunapat the Asura, all-possessing, God among Gods, the God with mead and butter shall bedew the paths.

verses.sa: मध्वा यज्ञं नक्षसे प्रीणानो नराशंसो अग्ने। सुकृद्देवः सविता विश्ववारः॥
verses.tr: madhvā yajñaṃ nakṣase prīṇāno narāśaṃso agne sukṛddevaḥ savitā viśvavāraḥ
verses.en: With mead to sacrifice thou comest, Agni, comest as friendly-minded Narasamsa, and Savitar righteous God who brings all blessings.

verses.sa: अच्छायमेति शवसा घृतेनेडानो वह्निर्नमसा। अग्निं स्रुचो अध्वरेषु प्रयत्सु॥
verses.tr: acchāyameti śavasā ghṛteneḍāno vahnirnamasā agniṃ sruco adhvareṣu prayatsu
verses.en: He Cometh hitherward with power and fatness, the luminous, implored with adoration. While rites proceed the ladles move to Agni.

verses.sa: स यक्षदस्य महिमानमग्नेः स ईं मन्द्रा सुप्रयसः। वसुश्चेतिष्ठो वसुधातमश्च॥
verses.tr: sa yakṣadasya mahimānamagneḥ sa īṃ mandrā suprayasaḥ vasuścetiṣṭho vasudhātamaśca
verses.en: Let him pay worship to this Agni's greatness, daintily fed: he verily ives enjoyments: The wisest Vasu he, and best wealth.

verses.sa: द्वारो देवीरन्वस्य विश्वे व्रता ददन्ते अग्नेः। उरुव्यचसो धाम्ना पत्यमानाः॥
verses.tr: dvāro devīranvasya viśve vratā dadante agneḥ uruvyacaso dhāmnā patyamānāḥ
verses.en: Widely expansive, ruling by foundation, the Doors divine—and, after, all—Preserve this: Agni's holy works.

verses.sa: ते अस्य योषणे दिव्ये न योना उषासानक्ता। इमं यज्ञमवतामध्वरं नः॥
verses.tr: te asya yoṣaṇe divye na yonā uṣāsānaktā imaṃ yajñamavatāmadhvaraṃ naḥ
verses.en: May Dawn and Night protect—his heavenly Consorts—in his home this our sacrificial worship.

verses.sa: दैव्या होतारा ऊर्ध्वमध्वरं नोऽग्नेर्जुह्वामभि गृणीतम्। कृणुतं नः स्विष्टम्॥
verses.tr: daivyā hotārā ūrdhvamadhvaraṃ no'gnerjuhvāmabhi gṛṇītam kṛṇutaṃ naḥ sviṣṭam
verses.en: Ye two celestial Hotars, greet with praises this lofty rite of ours, the tongue of Agni. Cause that our sacrifice be well conducted.

verses.sa: तिस्रो देवीर्बर्हिरेदं सदन्त्विडा सरस्वती भारती। मही गृणाना॥
verses.tr: tisro devīrbarhiredaṃ sadantviḍā sarasvatī bhāratī mahī gṛṇānā
verses.en: Upon this grass three Goddesses be seated, Ida, Sarasvati, Bharati the Mighty glorified with song.

verses.sa: तन्नस्तुरीपमद्भुतं पुरुक्षु त्वष्टा सुवीर्यम्। रायस्पोषं वि ष्यतु नाभिमस्मे॥
verses.tr: tannasturīpamadbhutaṃ purukṣu tvaṣṭā suvīryam rāyaspoṣaṃ vi ṣyatu nābhimasme
verses.en: This our productive wondrous flow may Tvashtar pour down on this man's kin, and wealth and heroes.

verses.sa: वनस्पतेऽव सृजा रराणस्त्मना देवेषु। अग्निर्हव्यं शमिता सूदयाति॥
verses.tr: vanaspate'va sṛjā rarāṇastmanā deveṣu agnirhavyaṃ śamitā sūdayāti
verses.en: Vanaspati, presenting of thyself, send God-ward! Let Agni, Immolator, season our oblation.

verses.sa: अग्ने स्वाहा कृणुहि जातवेद इन्द्राय हव्यम्। विश्वे देवा हविरिदं जुषन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: agne svāhā kṛṇuhi jātaveda indrāya havyam viśve devā haviridaṃ juṣantām
verses.en: Pay sacrifice to Indra, Jatavedas Agni! with Hail! All Gods accept the gift we offer!

verses.sa: पीवो अन्ना रयिवृधः सुमेधाः श्वेतः सिषक्ति नियुतामभिश्रीः। ते वायवे समनसो वि तस्थुर्विश्वेन्नरः स्वपत्यानि चक्रुः॥
verses.tr: pīvo annā rayivṛdhaḥ sumedhāḥ śvetaḥ siṣakti niyutāmabhiśrīḥ te vāyave samanaso vi tasthurviśvennaraḥ svapatyāni cakruḥ
verses.en: Wise, bright, arranger of his teams, he seeketh men with rich food whose treasures are abundant. They have stood firm of one accord with Vayu: yea, the men wrought all noble operations.

verses.sa: राये नु यं जज्ञतू रोदसीमे राये देवी धिषणा धाति देवम्। अध वायुं नियुतः सश्चत स्वा उत श्वेतं वसुधितिं निरेके॥
verses.tr: rāye nu yaṃ jajñatū rodasīme rāye devī dhiṣaṇā dhāti devam adha vāyuṃ niyutaḥ saścata svā uta śvetaṃ vasudhitiṃ nireke
verses.en: The God whom both these worlds brought forth for riches, whom heavenly Dhishana for our wealth appointeth—His team of harnessed horses waits on Vayu and, foremost, on the radiant treasure-holder.

verses.sa: आपो ह यद्बृहतीर्विश्वमायन् गर्भं दधाना जनयन्तीरग्निम्। ततो देवानां समवर्ततासुरेकः कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम॥
verses.tr: āpo ha yadbṛhatīrviśvamāyan garbhaṃ dadhānā janayantīragnim tato devānāṃ samavartatāsurekaḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.en: What, time the mighty waters came containing the universal germ, producing Agni, Thence sprang the Gods one spirit into being. What God shall we adore with our oblation?

verses.sa: यश्चिदापो महिना पर्यपश्यद्दक्षं दधाना जनयन्तीर्यज्ञम्। यो देवेष्वधि देव एक आसीत् कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम॥
verses.tr: yaścidāpo mahinā paryapaśyaddakṣaṃ dadhānā janayantīryajñam yo deveṣvadhi deva eka āsīt kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.en: Who in his might surveyed the floods enclosing productive force and generating Worship, He who is God mid Gods, and none beside him—What God shall we adore with our oblation?

verses.sa: प्र याभिर्यासि दाश्वांसमच्छा नियुद्भिर्वायविष्टये दुरोणे। नि नो रयिं सुभोजसं युवस्व नि वीरं गव्यमश्व्यं च राधः॥
verses.tr: pra yābhiryāsi dāśvāṃsamacchā niyudbhirvāyaviṣṭaye duroṇe ni no rayiṃ subhojasaṃ yuvasva ni vīraṃ gavyamaśvyaṃ ca rādhaḥ
verses.en: The teams wherewith thou seekest him who offers, within his house, O Vayu, to direct him, Therewith send wealth to us with full enjoyment, a hero son and gifts of kine and horses.

verses.sa: आ नो नियुद्भिः शतिनीभिरध्वरं सहस्रिणीभिरुप याहि यज्ञम्। वायो अस्मिन्त्सवने मादयस्व यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: ā no niyudbhiḥ śatinībhiradhvaraṃ sahasriṇībhirupa yāhi yajñam vāyo asmintsavane mādayasva yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: Vrata thy yoked teams in hundreds and in thousands come to our sacrifice and solemn worship. O Vayu, make thee glad at this libation. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa: नियुत्वान्वायवा गह्ययं शुक्रो अयामि ते। गन्तासि सुन्वतो गृहम्॥
verses.tr: niyutvānvāyavā gahyayaṃ śukro ayāmi te gantāsi sunvato gṛham
verses.en: Drawn by thy team, O Vayu, come; to thee is offered this, the pure. Thou visitest the presser's house.

verses.sa: वायो शुक्रो अयामि ते मध्वो अग्रं दिविष्टिषु। आ याहि सोमपीतये स्पार्हो देव नियुत्वता॥
verses.tr: vāyo śukro ayāmi te madhvo agraṃ diviṣṭiṣu ā yāhi somapītaye spārho deva niyutvatā
verses.en: Vayu, the bright is offered thee, best of the meath at holy rites. Come thou to drink the Soma juice, God longed-for, on thy team-drawn car.

verses.sa: वायुरग्रेगा यज्ञप्रीः साकं गन्मनसा यज्ञम्। शिवो नियुद्भिः शिवाभिः॥
verses.tr: vāyuragregā yajñaprīḥ sākaṃ ganmanasā yajñam śivo niyudbhiḥ śivābhiḥ
verses.en: Lover of worship, leader, come Vayu with thought, to sacrifice. Propitious with propitious teams!

verses.sa: वायो ये ते सहस्रिणो रथासस्तेभिरा गहि। नियुत्वान्त्सोमपीतये॥
verses.tr: vāyo ye te sahasriṇo rathāsastebhirā gahi niyutvāntsomapītaye
verses.en: With all the thousand chariots that are thine, O Vayu, come to us. Team-drawn, to drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa: एकया च दशभिश्च स्वभूते द्वाभ्यामिष्टये विंशती च। तिसृभिश्च वहसे त्रिंशता च नियुद्भिर्वायविह ता वि मुञ्च॥
verses.tr: ekayā ca daśabhiśca svabhūte dvābhyāmiṣṭaye viṃśatī ca tisṛbhiśca vahase triṃśatā ca niyudbhirvāyaviha tā vi muñca
verses.en: Come thou with one, and ten, O Self-Existent! with two unto the sacrifice, and twenty. Three are the teams and thirty which convey thee. O Vayu, in this place yoke thy coursers.

verses.sa: तव वायवृतस्पते त्वष्टुर्जामातरद्भुत। अवांस्या वृणीमहे॥
verses.tr: tava vāyavṛtaspate tvaṣṭurjāmātaradbhuta avāṃsyā vṛṇīmahe
verses.en: Wonderful Vayu, Lord of Truth, thou who art Tvashtar's Son-in-law, Thy saving succour we elect.

verses.sa: अभि त्वा शूर नोनुमोऽदुग्धा इव धेनवः। ईशानमस्य जगतः स्वर्दृशमीशानमिन्द्र तस्थुषः॥
verses.tr: abhi tvā śūra nonumo'dugdhā iva dhenavaḥ īśānamasya jagataḥ svardṛśamīśānamindra tasthuṣaḥ
verses.en: Like kine unmilked we call aloud. Hero, to thee and sing thy praise. Looker on heavenly light. Lord of this moving world, Lord, Indra! Of what moveth not.

verses.sa: न त्वावाँ२ अन्यो दिव्यो न पार्थिवो न जातो न जनिष्यते। अश्वायन्तो मघवन्निन्द्र वाजिनो गव्यन्तस्त्वा हवामहे॥
verses.tr: na tvāvāṃ2 anyo divyo na pārthivo na jāto na janiṣyate aśvāyanto maghavannindra vājino gavyantastvā havāmahe
verses.en: None other like to thee, of earth or of the heavens, hath been or ever will be born. Desiring horses, Indra, Bounteous Lord! and kine, as men of might we call on thee.

verses.sa: त्वामिद्धि हवामहे सातौ वाजस्य कारवः। त्वां वृत्रेष्विन्द्र सत्पतिं नरस्त्वां काष्ठास्वर्वतः॥
verses.tr: tvāmiddhi havāmahe sātau vājasya kāravaḥ tvāṃ vṛtreṣvindra satpatiṃ narastvāṃ kāṣṭhāsvarvataḥ
verses.en: That we may win us wealth and power, we poets call on only thee. In war men call on thee, Indra! the hero's Lord, in the steed's race-course call on thee a

verses.sa: स त्वं नश्चित्र वज्रहस्त धृष्णुया मह स्तवानो अद्रिवः। गामश्वं रथ्यमिन्द्र सं किर सत्रा वाजं न जिग्युषे॥
verses.tr: sa tvaṃ naścitra vajrahasta dhṛṣṇuyā maha stavāno adrivaḥ gāmaśvaṃ rathyamindra saṃ kira satrā vājaṃ na jigyuṣe
verses.en: As such, O Wonderful, whose hand holds thunder, praised as mighty, Caster of the Stone! Pour on us boldly, Indra, kine and chariot-steeds ever to be the conqueror's strength.

verses.sa: कया नश्चित्र आ भुवदूती सदावृधः सखा। कया शचिष्ठया वृता॥
verses.tr: kayā naścitra ā bhuvadūtī sadāvṛdhaḥ sakhā kayā śaciṣṭhayā vṛtā
verses.en: What succour will he bring to us, wonderful, ever-prospering Friend? With what most mighty company?

verses.sa: कस्त्वा सत्यो मदानां मंहिष्ठो मत्सदन्धसः। दृढा चिदारुजे वसु॥
verses.tr: kastvā satyo madānāṃ maṃhiṣṭho matsadandhasaḥ dṛḍhā cidāruje vasu
verses.en: What genuine and most liberal draught will spirit thee with juice to burst Open e'en strongly-guarded wealth?

verses.sa: अभी षु णः सखीनामविता जरितॄणाम्। शतं भवास्यूतये॥
verses.tr: abhī ṣu ṇaḥ sakhīnāmavitā jaritṝṇām śataṃ bhavāsyūtaye
verses.en: Do thou who art protector of us thy friends who praise thee With hundred aids approach us.

verses.sa: यज्ञा-यज्ञा वो अग्नये गिरा-गिरा च दक्षसे। प्र-प्र वयममृतं जातवेदसं प्रियं मित्रं न शंसिषम्॥
verses.tr: yajñā-yajñā vo agnaye girā-girā ca dakṣase pra-pra vayamamṛtaṃ jātavedasaṃ priyaṃ mitraṃ na śaṃsiṣam
verses.en: Sing to your Agni with each song, at every sacrifice, for strength. Come, let us praise the Wise and Everlasting God even as a well-beloved Friend.

verses.sa: पाहि नो अग्न एकया पाह्युत द्वितीयया। पाहि गीर्भिस्तिसृभिरूर्जां पते पाहि चतसृभिर्वसो॥
verses.tr: pāhi no agna ekayā pāhyuta dvitīyayā pāhi gīrbhistisṛbhirūrjāṃ pate pāhi catasṛbhirvaso
verses.en: Protect us, Agni, through the first, protect us through the second hymn. Protect us through three hymns, O Lord of Power and Might; through four hymns, Vasu! guard thou us.

verses.sa: ऊर्जो नपातं स हिनायमस्मयुर्दाशेम हव्यदातये। भुवद्वाजेष्वविता भुवद्वृध उत त्राता तनूनाम्॥
verses.tr: ūrjo napātaṃ sa hināyamasmayurdāśema havyadātaye bhuvadvājeṣvavitā bhuvadvṛdha uta trātā tanūnām
verses.en: The Son of Strength; for is he not our Friend? Let us serve him for offering our gifts. In battles may he be our help and strengthener, yea, be the saviour of our lives.

verses.sa: संवत्सरोऽसि परिवत्सरोऽसीदावत्सरोऽसीद्वत्सरोऽसि वत्सरोऽसि। उषसस्ते कल्पन्तामहोरात्रास्ते कल्पन्तामर्धमासास्ते कल्पन्तां मासास्ते कल्पन्तामृतवस्ते कल्पन्तां संवत्सरस्ते कल्पताम्। प्रेत्या एत्यै सं चाञ्च प्र च सारय। सुपर्णचिदसि तया देवतयाऽङ्गिरस्वद् ध्रुवः सीद॥
verses.tr: saṃvatsaro'si parivatsaro'sīdāvatsaro'sīdvatsaro'si vatsaro'si uṣasaste kalpantāmahorātrāste kalpantāmardhamāsāste kalpantāṃ māsāste kalpantāmṛtavaste kalpantāṃ saṃvatsaraste kalpatām pretyā etyai saṃ cāñca pra ca sāraya suparṇacidasi tayā devatayā'ṅgirasvad dhruvaḥ sīda
verses.en: Thou art Sariivatsara; thou art Parivatsara; thou art Ida vatsara; thou art Idvatsara; thou art Parivatsara. Prosper thy Dawns! Prosper thy Day-and-Nights! Prosper thy Half-months, Months, Seasons, and Years! Combine them for their going and their coming, and send them forward on their ordered courses. In eagle's shape thou art piled up and layered. With that divinity, Angiras-like, lie steady.
